output.title: Aerobic Base Introduction Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 10 min easy walking and light jogging at Zone 1 (7:00 /km) → Steady continuous aerobic running 35 min in Zone 2 below AeT (5:30 /km) → Cool down 5 min walking and light mobility. Overall: First session of the foundational base period, establishing baseline aerobic capillary stimulus on flat terrain. The effort is kept conversational and strictly below aerobic threshold. Reason: Opens the training block following a clean aerobic structure, introducing consistent volume without inducing neuromuscular fatigue. Benefit: Enhances slow-twitch muscle fiber recruitment, mitochondrial density, and fat oxidation efficiency. Warning: Strictly respect the 128 bpm ceiling; slow to a walk if cardiac drift occurs.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: General Bodyweight Strength & Chassis Integrity
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min dynamic mobility, hip openers, and leg swings → Bodyweight Squats: 3x10, 90s rest → Reverse Lunges: 3x10 each leg, 90s rest → Single-Leg Glute Bridges: 3x10 each leg, 60s rest → Step-Ups to 30cm bench: 3x10 each leg, 90s rest → Calf Raises: 3x15, 60s rest → Cool down 5 min stretching and mobility. Overall: Foundational bodyweight strength routine focused on pelvic control, knee alignment, and tendon durability without gym apparatus. Every set is executed with controlled tempo and pristine biomechanics. Reason: Establishes movement competency and joint resilience for upcoming mountain trail loads and downhill forces. Benefit: Increases tendon stiffness, glute activation, and joint stability to safeguard bone mineral density and prevent patellofemoral strain. Warning: Maintain pristine spinal and knee tracking; cease immediately if tendon discomfort arises.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Scheduled Rest & Regeneration
output.description: Process: Rest day with zero training load. Overall: Full passive rest to allow musculoskeletal recovery and hormonal adaptation. Reason: Prepares the peripheral nervous system and lower-leg connective tissues for the weekend aerobic stimulus. Benefit: Enables cellular protein synthesis, glycogen restoration, and physiological recovery. Warning: Avoid strenuous yard work or extended periods on your feet.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Aerobic Foundation Run + Flat Strides
output.description: Process: Warm up 10 min easy jog in Zone 1 (6:30 /km) → 35 min steady aerobic running in Zone 2 below AeT (5:25 /km) → 5 min flat neuromuscular strides consisting of 5 x 20-second accelerations at Zone 4 pace (4:15 /km) with 40-second walk recoveries → Cool down 5 min walking. Overall: Gentle continuous aerobic running complemented by light, non-fatiguing flat strides to recruit fast-twitch fibers without accumulating lactate. Keeps stride dynamics supple and lively on flat pavement. Reason: Imparts gentle neuromuscular coordination and turnover while honoring the constraint of flat terrain and no hills. Benefit: Enhances motor unit recruitment and running economy while reinforcing mitochondrial base development. Warning: Strides must be relaxed and submaximal; do not sprint aggressively or strain hamstrings.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbs needed.

output.title: Aerobic Endurance Long Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 10 min easy progression in Zone 1 (6:40 /km) → 60 min continuous steady aerobic run held strictly below AeT in Zone 2 (5:35 /km) → Cool down 5 min walking and lower-body stretching. Overall: The primary endurance stimulus of the week, capped strictly under 33% of total weekly volume. Builds sustained aerobic output and mental resilience on flat terrain. Reason: Develops slow-twitch oxidative efficiency and peripheral vascularization while maintaining low systemic stress. Benefit: Promotes lipid metabolism, increases cardiac stroke volume, and builds structural tolerance for long trail races. Warning: Do not chase pace if fatigued; keep heart rate below 128 bpm regardless of external conditions.
output.fueling_tip: 30-60g carbohydrates per hour + 300-500mg sodium/hr with 400-600ml water/hr.
